Du entwickelst stabile und skalierbare Datenpipelines, stellst eine hohe Datenqualität sicher und schaffst die technische Grundlage für datenbasierte Entscheidungen. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, People, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin. Deine Aufgaben: Datenplattform & Architektur Den Aufbau, Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung unserer skalierbaren Datenplattform auf Basis moderner Warehouse-, Data-Lake- oder Lakehouse-Architekturen verantwortest Du eigenständig. Robuste ETL- und ELT-Pipelines zur Integration unterschiedlicher Datenquellen entwickelst, optimierst und wartest Du kontinuierlich. jobs.description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. About the role The MLOps team at Gravis builds the data flow that turns raw recordings from our autonomous earthmoving machines (LiDAR point clouds, camera images, GNSS positions and hydraulic signals) into clean, searchable, training-ready datasets for our autonomy models. As an intern, you will learn how data moves through Gravis today, explore data pipeline tools and try the most promising ones on real fleet data, and have the opportunity to help build a pipeline that runs in production on our GPU clusters and is used by our ML and robotics engineers every day, with direct mentorship from senior engineers. We are looking for a motivated student or recent graduate with a background in computer science, data science or a related field and a solid foundation in Python and data processing, available to start in early 2027. jobs.description: Join Sport Alliance’s Data Products team and build ML solutions for Magicline and PerfectGym Next, used by thousands of fitness businesses and millions of members. You’ll work closely with engineers and product managers to take ML use cases from idea to production, with plenty of ownership and the opportunity to shape how we use ML and AI across our products. Your position in our team Build and deploy production-ready ML solutions, with a focus on classical ML and statistical methods. Own your models end-to-end — from data pipelines and modelling to deployment and monitoring. Improve the scalability and reliability of our existing ML data pipelines. Work closely with software engineers and product managers to turn business problems into practical solutions. Be the Data Science expert in a small Data Products team alongside two data engineers and one data analyst. Identify where ML and GenAI can solve real product and business problems, and choose the right approach. Work with our platform and LLM Ops teams when additional infrastructure support is needed. Help shape our ML and AI roadmap, identifying high-impact opportunities and influencing how ML capabilities evolve across our products. Your profile 5+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning solutions in production. Strong knowledge of statistics and classical ML, with good judgment about which approach fits the problem, scale, and cost. Experience owning ML projects end-to-end, including data preparation, modelling, deployment, and monitoring. Strong hands-on Python skills (scikit-learn or similar frameworks) and SQL. You’re proactive and comfortable working on problems that aren’t fully defined yet. You communicate clearly and work well with both technical and non-technical colleagues. English at C1 level or above. Nice to have Experience with AWS, Terraform, or dbt. Experience working with LLMs or GenAI-based solutions. German language skills. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer – Models in Production (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Anyone can train a model in a notebook these days. Getting it into production, keeping it accurate month after month and turning its output into decisions people actually make is a different story. That's the job. For a renowned automotive manufacturer in Munich, we are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who builds models that matter for a premium brand. You work with structured and unstructured data, take models all the way into production and make sure they keep delivering. Your results shape strategic decisions and the experience of customers who expect nothing less than premium. What makes this role different You don't build models that end up in a slide deck. You own them end to end, from the raw data to the deployed model to the insight a decision maker acts on. One client, one location, one team in Munich, with direct access to the people who use your work. And you are the person who brings machine learning into the business. You explain what a model can and cannot do, teach colleagues how to use it and help them ask better questions of their data. Degree or not, what counts is what you have built. If you have a proven track record of shipping machine learning applications, for example in open source, that is as valuable to us as a degree. The goal is ambitious. Move machine learning out of experiments and into the decisions a premium brand makes every day, from strategy to the experience of its customers. jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: Who are we? At UpGuard , we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process around 10 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk. We build the Risk Operations Center, the AI platform where lean security teams run cyber risk end to end. It combines security ratings, threat intelligence and AI agents to give teams one view of risk across their vendors, attack surface and workforce. We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale. Where does this role fit in? UpGuard has recently replatformed its analytics stack onto a greenfield foundation built on BigQuery, dbt, infrastructure as code in OpenTofu, CI/CD through GitHub, and a governed semantic layer that both people and AI agents query. We are seeking an experienced data engineer to help take that platform to the next level. Reporting to the Director of Data Engineering, this role is the strong technical lead within the data engineering team. You will work under the Director's guidance to evolve the platform and raise its engineering standards, and you will set the example for how the team builds, reviews and ships. The platform has a broad contributor and consumer base. Analysts, data scientists and business teams build on it, query it and increasingly reach it through AI agents. Keeping those stakeholders well served and satisfied is a central measure of success in this role. What will you do? Technical Leadership: Act as the senior technical voice within the data engineering team by guiding design decisions, reviewing code, mentoring engineers and contributing to the platform roadmap set by the team. jobs.title: Machine Learning & AI Internship
jobs.description: WHY this position is important Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it. The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot : automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible. These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production. HOW you will contribute You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor. Every topic follows the same path: Evaluation first : in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter. A baseline in production : you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3. Then go further : you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result. You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results. Topics for 2027 Here is an overview of the topics we want to staff in 2027. We agree on the final topic and your tutor with you. jobs.description: Outsight’s software solutions track the motion of people and vehicles using 3D LiDAR data. Operators of transportation hubs like airports and train stations but also sport venues, road infrastructures and industrial sites can now access accurate and anonymous Spatial Intelligence data, in order to improve operations and increase user safety and satisfaction. Our international team of scientists and engineers drive the development of our solutions from Paris, San Francisco, Sophia-Antipolis (Nice), Singapore & Hong Kong. To support our global outreach, we also operate a commercial office in Spain. You can find below an interesting link about who we are and what we do : Insights about Outsight Our Passenger Flow Traffic Monitoring solution is trusted by the world’s leading airports and train stations across four continents, including the most renowned hubs celebrated for their operational excellence and exceptional passenger experience. We also deploy our solutions in other markets such as Tourism, Retail and Sports. Additionally, our Car Traffic Remote Monitoring product is trusted by several Tier 1 customers, including BMW. Context We are seeking a senior systems thinker to anchor the data lifecycle of Outsight's spatial events. This individual will own the structural flow of high-volume event data processing from our internal Perception stack and 3rd-party datasets, translating them into well-modeled, hyper-performant warehouse layers and clean semantic models.
